review_description: From the moment SGS came into the picture with their quote from SolarQuotes it was easy and went along really smooth.I was that impressed by the team that I also got them to replace some failing split system air conditioners. If that doesnt say enough, I dont know what else will.

I recently went with SGS Solar, and the entire experience was excellent from start to finish. Their pricing was very competitive compared to other quotes I received, and communication was always clear, quick, and easy.The installation team was professional, punctual, and worked efficiently. They completed the job much faster than I expected, and the workmanship was clean and high-quality. Everything was explained properly, and the system has been performing well since day one.Overall, I’m extremely happy with SGS Solar and would confidently recommend them to anyone looking for a smooth, reliable and well-priced solar installation. Great service and a great company to deal with!
Quote to install was smooth and the actually turned up to take a look at the roof
Sales and information was excellent.Installation was on time, tidy, and very good.Great assistance and knowledge with setting up.

What a great team! Quote was swift after initial inquiry. Glenn went through everything in detail without blinding me with science. The install was excellent as we were also in the process of repainting the roof so SGS were more than happy to work around the other trades time frames. Performing the install in two parts to suit. Extremely happy with the service and the quality.

Glenn,Alex and the team were fantastic to deal with. They were honest, reliable, hard working and a pleasure to work with. The installation team left the job sight spotless and were kind and respectful the whole time.Alex connected me to the apps I needed and was patient and explained everything well.I highly recommend this fantastic business.
Everything was done very smoothly. Good job done by installers.

The quoting process and installation was fine and all the above issues were met in a timely and pleasant manner.However the after sales service has been almost non existent.  My first phone call was promptly returned.On October 27 our inverter disconnected from Wi-fi.  Of course we did not understand why and the repercussions thereof, so I phoned SGS at 7.52am and left a message.  With no response to my call I phoned again at 11.01 to the mobile and at 11.38 to landline no.  I was understandably anxious.  My calls were returned at 12.06 pm and clearly not well received.  I was told that "I told you I would always get back to you.  If you expect me to keep coming out to you there will have to be charges involved.  I took this as a veiled threat and am reluctant to call again.  I had not asked or expected him to come out to me; I was just after some explanation.  He sent me a link to reconnect, but despite many many attempts this did not happen.  I let him know this and he said he would send someone around that day.  He later sent a text to say they had had a big day and would not be coming. The next day the inverter was up and running again and was described as a "glitch".  On November, I advised that the inverter again disconnected from the Wi-f and that once again that I had followed the instructions to reconnect  but again could not effect reconnection.  He contacted me on Monday and said someone would come around that morning and I told him I was not home till after 1.00pm.  Still have not had any follow up.I decided to put in an enquiry direct to Goodwe.  And when doing this on or about 18 or 19/11 I went out to check the Serial no and discovered that the inverter was again disconnected from Wi-fi.  3 times in this short period of time signals more that a "glitch".  Particularly as everything else was still connected.If I don't get a favorable response from Goodwe, my next step will have to be Fair Trading/Obudsman.  I have paid out good money and don't think my expectations are too high.To add insult to injury before the installation I enquired about a Sungro inverter but was told they were not available in 3 phase which I later found out was incorrect.  No happy Jan.
SGS were a pleasure to work with especially given the more “custom” requirements of my install. Great workmanship, communication and service overall.

I highly recommend using SGS Electrical for your Solar installation. I obtained 5 quotes from different suppliers and Glen was by far the most helpful, professional, and competitive. He offers the best quality products, and several options for consideration. Glen explains very well in plain English that is easy to understand. He does what he says he will do, kept me informed at every stage, was always available for phone calls, texts, or by email. The customer service is excellent. The installers were also professional and friendly, cleaning up after themselves and explaining how the system works. We are very confident that we got quality products at a competitive price through an honest and trustworthy operator giving good old fashioned service.

Glenn was fantastic and kept in contact the entire time. We had some issues with body corporate but Glenn was understanding and professional. The team he has are great and I have recommended Glenn and his team to family and friends.

SGS Electrical were wonderful to deal with. Glen was professional and knowledgeable and provided outstanding customer service.The team at SGS that installed my system were extremely experienced and completed the job with a high level of workmanship.Glen went the extra mile on my job by working with me to design the best layout and positioning of my panels and also by sourcing additional roof tiles should any become damaged during installation. In the end we didn’t need them but the fact that he understood my concerns put my mind at ease.I highly recommend SGS Solar.

I recently had solar panels installed and the team at SGS Electrical were were amazing.They turned up when they said they would for the quoting process at a time that was suitable to me.During the installation they were very professional and communicated throughout the entire process.My electrical cabling was a bit more complex than the average job, but the team left everything very clean and tidy.  They organised everything including the grid connection after installation. I can only speak highly of SGS Electrical.

Wow what a great bunch of blokes I wasn’t sure what I needed when I started to look but, these guys helped explain it all and then gave me a great deal on a 12.7kw battery ready system, and when it came to the install the blokes were great even fixing a few broken tiles, even with shit weather they did what they could and worked in between the weather it took an extra day because the rain was pissing down but that was explained.I would definitely recommend these blokes

Sales process with Dewayne was very goodInstallation was really good - very polite and punctual - minimum of time wasted. Extra jobs completed @ good ratesCustomer service is good and paperwork for follow up contacts was punctual. Had a few problems with roof leaking, and follow up has been excellent

It was great to work with the SGS team - special call out to Dewayne who kept me updated at all steps through out the process and was transparent with next steps too. The SGS team did phenomenal effort and provided a clean handover at the end. All of this while I was not even on-site for the installation.
SGS has a wealth of knowledge that they share in the process. They are adaptive to client needs in the purchase decision and proactive in ensuring needs are met.

Sales quoting good, Installation all of the above. Yes they helped with grid connection after install.We did not get quotes from the 4 you suggested, only two of them. They were all good but we had to choose only 1 and that was SGS Electrical.

Right from the get go SGS Electrical were awesome to deal with. They were prompt and professional providing us with clear options and were transparent around costs. One of the solar companys we comtacted didnt even get back to us. Having done research via Solar Quotes we were, I wouldnt say all over it but we were confident enough so to speak  to know what we wanted. With that in mind any questions we asked or changes we wanted were acted on promptly by SGS Electrical. They were excellent to deal with and not once did we feel any pressure from them to go with their quote or any particular product they offered. They were clear with all their communications so the whole process was easy to grasp and therefore stress free! Installation was great. The SGS Electrical guys were fine and just got on and done the job. Look initially we started corresponding with SGS Electrical because they were the quickest to reply to our requests. I mean we well into it before we heard from others. We got a quote from an outside source also and that one was just not going to fly. But we think we lucked out because they were excellent and I would recommend SGS Electrical to anyone wanting to use them.
On time, efficient, clean, work as a team, in and out. Quality of install, exceptional.
Whole process from start to finish went exactly as described. Purchased a high quality system for a good price. Highly recommend!!!!

Owner was very knowledgable. My toughest decision was which combination of inverter and panels was best for my house - they gave excellent advice and weren't pushy.Install was within two weeks and workers were very professional.Very happy with the service.
- Sales process very smooth- Installer polite and punctual- No, they didn't organise the grid connection
